summaries.Romania: Romania faces political uncertainty as the newly proposed government prepares parliamentary hearings while energy prices surge and healthcare reforms advance. Key institutional debates continue over electoral procedures and governance amid economic pressures.
summaries.Healthcare: FDA leadership and drug pricing emerge as critical policy battlegrounds, with Trump's nominee facing scrutiny while healthcare systems grapple with AI integration, nursing shortages, and affordability challenges. Innovation accelerates in insulin, gene therapy, and AI-assisted care.
summaries.Tech: Apple prepares major hardware releases with leaked iPad mini and HomePod updates while broader tech industry confronts AI safety concerns, with OpenAI and Anthropic facing regulatory pressure and security incidents. Competition intensifies across AI models, cloud infrastructure, and consumer devices.

items.title: Premierul desemnat Siegfried Mureșan depune azi la Parlament programul de guvernare şi lista de miniştri
items.snippet: Premierul desemnat Siegfried Mureşan depune sâmbătă dimineaţa la Parlament programul de guvernare şi lista de miniştri, urmând ca audierile şi votul în plen să aibă loc la începutul săptămânii viitoare, transmite Agerpres. Mureşan este a treia propunere de premier pe care a făcut-o preşedintele Nicu
items.line: Romania's new government formation directly affects EU relations, energy policy, and fiscal credibility as Standard & Poor's prepares to rate the country.

items.title: Trump administration uses rare authority to claw back nearly $1B in spending approved by Congress
items.snippet: President Trump is canceling nearly $1 billion in spending approved by Congress, and most of the cuts are focused on HHS programs that serve refugees and unaccompanied minors.
items.line: Trump administration's $1B cut to HHS refugee and minor services reverses critical healthcare infrastructure impacting vulnerable populations nationwide.

items.title: Unsecured OpenAI agents posted 53 user images on the internet without the lab’s knowledge

items.title: STAT+: Lilly wins approval for once-weekly insulin shot
items.snippet: The FDA approved Eli Lilly’s Onswik, a once-weekly basal insulin for adults with type 2 diabetes, offering patients an alternative to daily long-acting insulin injections.
items.line: Eli Lilly's once-weekly insulin represents significant improvement in type 2 diabetes management and adherence for millions of patients.

items.title: Anthropic to pay Akamai $11.6 billion over seven years in cloud deal
items.snippet: Anthropic has committed $11.6 billion over seven years to Akamai's cloud infrastructure, a bet on CPUs that could grow to about $20 billion, and in an unusual arrangement, Akamai is giving Anthropic a potential stake of up to 5% of its stock that grows as Anthropic spends more.
items.line: Anthropic's $11.6B Akamai commitment with potential equity stake restructures AI infrastructure economics and long-term computing dependencies.

items.title: Anthropic’s founders seek voting control ahead of IPO
items.snippet: Anthropic is asking its shareholders to approve a structure that would give its seven co-founders a combined 50.1% of the vote on most corporate matters.
items.line: Anthropic founders seeking voting control ahead of IPO reflects governance tensions between venture backers and founding team during AI scaling phase.
